brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides a 2-cell by 2-storey frame (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full with snap connectors and cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top forming shelf surfaces). The configurator only checks geometry/fit (check_build meshClash: clear) and does not simulate structural strength or load ratings per instructions: do not claim load ratings. No 50 kg verification is possible in Hex Cluster.

Two notch drawer frames installed at lower level bridging adjacent bases: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at q0,1) and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at q1,-1). Each provides a drawer position between the two base cells.

finish.summary: Built modest 2-wide x 2-high shelf frame with top covers as shelf surfaces and two notch drawer frames for drawers. Mesh clash clear. 50 kg rating cannot be verified by the configurator (fit-only check) - must be validated by engineering/load testing outside this tool. Two-drawer requirement met via installed notch drawer frames.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
